Time series forecasting plays a critical role in decision-making across many real-world applications.

We propose T-LLM, a temporal distillation framework that equips general-purpose LLMs with time series forecasting capability by transferring predictive behavior from a lightweight temporal teacher during training.
large language models (LLMs)
The teacher combines trend modeling and frequency-domain analysis to provide structured temporal supervision, and is removed entirely at inference, leaving the LLM as the sole forecasting model.

Experiments on benchmark datasets and infectious disease forecasting tasks demonstrate that T-LLM consistently outperforms existing LLM-based forecasting methods under full-shot, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, while enabling a simple and efficient deployment pipeline.

This study presents the development and evaluation of an FL image classification model across various scenarios—utilizing the SQUARES prototype.

Inference serving for large language models (LLMs) is the key to unleashing their potential in people's daily lives.
We introduce Llumnix, an LLM serving system that reacts to such heterogeneous and unpredictable requests by runtime rescheduling across multiple model instances.
large language models (LLMs)

Llumnix implements the rescheduling with an efficient and scalable live migration mechanism for requests and their in-memory states, and exploits it in a dynamic scheduling policy that unifies the multiple rescheduling scenarios elegantly.
Llumnix is publicly available at https://github.com/AlibabaPAI/llumnix.
In the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Development and Operations (DevOps) has been proven to deliver reliable, scalable software within a shorter time.
This paper explains the DevOps and MLOps processes relevant to the implementation of MLOps.

The 3D reconstruction of simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is an important topic in the field for transport systems such as drones, service robots and mobile AR/VR devices.
This article reviews the implementation of a visual-based 3D scene reconstruction pipeline on resource-constrained hardware platforms.
The potential use of deep learning
Real-time performances, memory management and low power consumption are critical for embedded systems.
Recent systems propose the embedded implementation of 3D reconstruction methods with different granularities.
Evolutionary algorithms (EAs) and swarm algorithms (SAs) have shown their usefulness in solving combinatorial and NP-hard optimization problems in various research fields.

In this study, inspired by the recent development of deep neural networks in computer vision, which embed large-scale optimization problems, we first describe a literature survey conducted to compensate for the lack of relevant research in this area.

Specifically, applications related to the genetic algorithm and differential evolution from EAs, as well as particle swarm optimization and ant colony optimization from SAs and their variants, are mainly considered in this survey.

UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) target detection technology has been widely applied in various fields including intelligent security, agricultural monitoring, traffic supervision and emergency rescue due to its advantages of high mobility, wide coverage and fast response.

As a benchmark in the field of real-time target detection, the YOLO (You Only Look Once) series algorithms have become the preferred solution for UAV target detection with the characteristics of end-to-end inference and a well-balanced performance between high precision and high speed.
YOLO (You Only Look Once) series algorithms

lightweight technology enables the efficient adaptation of YOLO algorithms to UAV on-board edge devices by compressing model volume, reducing computational complexity and improving inference speed on the premise of ensuring controllable detection accuracy.

This study finds that multi-technology synergistic optimization (e.g., GhostNet + INT8 quantization + knowledge distillation) can reduce model parameters to as low as $\mathbf{3. 1 M}$ and improve inference speed to $\mathbf{1 0 5}$ FPS(Frames Per Second) while maintaining mAP above 37.8% on the UAVDT dataset.
Recent advances in IoT have enabled edge-cloud collaborative surveillance systems, addressing latency, bandwidth, and privacy issues of traditional cloud-only approaches in home security.

This paper surveys architectures emphasizing portable, resource-constrained devices like ESP32, highlighting how edge intelligence with cloud support enhances efficiency, scalability, and real-time decision-making.

This paper presents a comprehensive survey of deep learning (DL) models, systematically categorizing them from foundational architectures such as multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to advanced frameworks like transformers, generative adversarial networks (GANs), large language models (LLMs), and large multimodal models (LMMs).
The survey reviews core mechanisms, architectures, and applications across domains, including computer vision, natural language processing, healthcare, and robotics.

With the increasing use of surveillance cameras, face recognition is being studied by many researchers for security purposes.
This paper mainly focuses on SRC and its extended methods of face recognition.
sparse representation based classiﬁcation (SRC)
Recently, sparse representation based classiﬁcation (SRC) has shown the state-of-the-art result in face recognition on corrupt and occluded face images.
SRC methods have been compared on the basis of ﬁve issues of face recognition such as linear variation, non-linear variation, undersampled, pose variation, and low resolution.

A large number of modern mobile devices, embedded devices and smart home devices are equipped with a voice control.
This work is a systematic literature review on voice activation systems that satisfy the above properties.
acoustic modelling

The voice activation system must have the following properties: high accuracy, ability to work entirely on the device (without using remote servers), consumption of a small amount of resources (primarily CPU and RAM), noise resistance and variability of speech, as well as a small delay between the pronunciation of the key phrase and the system activation.
most of these devices use a voice activation system, whose task is to find the specified in advance word or phrase in the audio stream

The ever-increasing volume of unstructured data in image and text format has posed a major challenge to conventional data analytics.
This work is a review of the integration of deep learning methods with data analytics platforms for efficient visual and textual knowledge extraction.
convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and transformers

Various state-of-the-art deep learning models such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and transformers are investigated for feature extraction, pattern matching and semantic interpretation in image and text mining applications.
Use cases in various fields including medicine, social media, document understanding, security and recommendation systems are explored to showcase the impact of this approach.
LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume.
We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer.
1.1B-parameter models

By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics.
We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation.
